purpose: Desk-run of RF-PF retention/forgetting prediction questions against compact retain/minimize/next lines. This is not a human study; it records expected operator misreads so Schell can simplify vocabulary before architecture promotion.

run_method.promotion_consequence: architecture remains blocked because fail/mixed rows expose vocabulary gaps

compact_line_variants.shape: retain: <surface> · minimize: <reason> · next: <safe latch>; <blocked effect> blocked
compact_line_variants.observed_problem: fast but hides object family, copies, branch, owner, proof lost, and influence lanes.

compact_line_variants.shape: retain / why / copies / lineage / proof-lost / owner / next / blocked
compact_line_variants.observed_problem: more legible for hazards but too heavy for always-on chrome.

compact_line_variants.shape: one-line chip plus mandatory drawer before effect verbs
compact_line_variants.observed_problem: keeps glance compact while forcing details before share/rerun/tool-call/open/deploy/claim-erased.

case_results.compact_line: retain: history/search · minimize: purpose expired pii · next: reveal budget/sweep proof; share raw blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator can see purpose expired but cannot name object family or all copy lanes without drawer
case_results.change_required: compact line should expose object_family and copies before share/rerun/tool-call

case_results.compact_line: retain: telemetry/export · minimize: redaction after export gap · next: reveal pipeline order; export telemetry blocked
case_results.observed_misread: pipeline order and export boundary are readable
case_results.change_required: keep line but require pre-export witness row

case_results.compact_line: retain: ci artifact · minimize: nonretroactive retention policy · next: reveal old-object proof; download artifact blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator can see nonretroactivity but not policy epoch or whether old objects were migrated

case_results.compact_line: retain: helper memory · minimize: helper summary residue · next: reveal helper copies; tool-call blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator treats deleted raw context as forgotten helper influence
case_results.change_required: add helper influence lane and loaded_context_manifest field

case_results.compact_line: retain: legal hold · minimize: hold blocks forgetting · next: reveal hold scope; claim erased blocked
case_results.observed_misread: hold authority and access restriction are visible enough for a static board
case_results.change_required: keep hold rows but require owner/escalation in leases

case_results.compact_line: retain: search index · minimize: raw absent index retained · next: reveal index sweep; claim erased blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator knows index exists but not whether result came from accepted prefix or discarded suffix
case_results.change_required: bind search index entries to transcript lineage/branch state

case_results.compact_line: retain: archive compaction · minimize: summary only compaction · next: reveal budget/sweep proof; approve follow-up blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator sees summary-only but cannot name which proof was destroyed from the compact line alone

case_results.compact_line: retain: team pin · minimize: source revoke not propagated · next: reveal audience sweep; rerun blocked
case_results.observed_misread: pin residue is visible but source branch/currentness is not
case_results.change_required: link team pins to receiver packet and transcript branch

case_results.compact_line: retain: semantic/vector · minimize: raw swept but influence retained · next: trace/rebuild; tool call blocked
case_results.observed_misread: semantic influence is too easy to miss if only raw/copy lanes are shown
case_results.change_required: make influence_lane first-class in compact line and taxonomy

case_results.compact_line: retain: tombstone ledger · minimize: tombstone data class unknown · next: budget/audience row; share tombstone blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator assumes tombstone is safe metadata and misses second-order incident leak
case_results.change_required: add tombstone privacy budget fields and lint

case_results.compact_line: retain: receiver ledger · minimize: local row removed but receivers unknown · next: reveal receiver packet/post-sweep witness; claim erased blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator treats local deletion as enough and misses team, clipboard, OpenURI, backup, and third-party receiver copies
case_results.change_required: add receiver forgetting ledger and require receiver owner/post-sweep witness before claim-erased or share verbs

case_results.compact_line: retain: claim fence · minimize: cleanup witnessed only locally · next: show allowed/blocked claim; compliance claim blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator understands weaker local claim but still reaches for sanitized/compliant language when a policy or TTL exists
case_results.change_required: show allowed claim and blocked stronger claim side by side on Memory Authority Card

case_results.compact_line: retain: semantic/vector · minimize: raw swept but derivative influence · next: show rebuild epoch + semantic miss; answer/tool-call blocked
case_results.observed_misread: operator treats raw deletion as enough because the card does not show exact lookup miss versus semantic-near miss
case_results.change_required: add forgetting probe grade and influence quarantine to Memory Authority Card drawer

observed_failures: copy lane and memory object family collapse in compact lines
semantic/vector influence is invisible when raw text is gone
proof loss from compaction/redaction is not concrete enough
policy epochs and object birth epochs are missing from nonretroactive retention cases
team pins/search indexes need transcript branch binding
tombstone metadata needs its own privacy budget and audience row
receiver copies remain invisible unless the compact card names receiver owner and post-sweep witness
operators overclaim sanitized/anonymized/compliant language when cleanup vocabulary is not fenced
Forgetting language needs probe grades; raw deletion and local row absence are over-read without exact lookup miss / semantic-near miss / receiver acknowledgement labels.
vocabulary_changes: Add memory object taxonomy beside copy lanes.
Add lineage branch / accepted-prefix / discarded-suffix row before effects.
Treat retention as a lease/grant with owner, expiry, renewal authority, forgetting authority, and receiver packet.
Use two-tier compact lines: short chip at glance; mandatory drawer for authority-bearing verbs.
add receiver packet row to memory authority drawer
add claim fence row showing allowed claim and blocked stronger claim
